_doc: Codepoints kept in the UI font subsets (docs/07 s7: Latin + Latin-Ext; ART-21). Read by tools/art/subset_font.py. Covers EN + FI (aao with diacritics) and the other Latin-1/Latin Extended-A locales. 'tabular' codepoints use the font's fixed-advance digit glyphs (timers). Web payload budget 150 KB.
